purpose: Files that spell out three or more members of an enum declared in src/lib/validation/enums.js instead of deriving from it, recorded as accepted debt on 2026-08-17. CLAUDE.md already forbids hand-copying an enum list; this list is what that rule cost before it was enforced. It may only shrink: preflight raises a CRITICAL for any copy not listed here. Never add an entry to silence a new one. An INCOMPLETE copy is the dangerous shape — two independent copies of WORK_STATUSES both dropped CANCELLED, so a work item in that status renders nowhere. See .brain/rca/2026-08-17-a-prose-rule-is-not-a-gate.md. The final deliberate audit-vocabulary copy was repaid on 2026-08-21 by declaring AUDIT_ENTITY_TYPES as its own source of truth and deriving the Audit browser from it; no accepted copies remain.
